name: luma-guest-registered-to-event-attendance
description: Luma guest registered -> upsert Notion Event Attendance (resolve event + contact, set Approval Status). A Work Email registration answer becomes the contact's Primary Email; the Luma account address is kept as a Secondary. A ticked newsletter opt-in answer subscribes the guest in Buttondown, last, so the Buttondown -> Contacts automation can't race this one into a duplicate contact. A registration that creates a brand-new contact is flagged `Possible duplicate of` every name-equivalent existing contact (tokens sorted, so a reversed name order still matches), so an unindexed address can't quietly produce a second copy.
